_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A coalesced idle patch clears optimistic Thinking for a conversation the list already had: the conversation list snapshot the page loads lists the conversation /c/{{SLUG}}, idle. The page's /api/stream2 EventSource gets no answer until call "release"; then it receives a single conversation list patch, coalesced, that shows the conversation idle with two more messages. Sending a message is accepted (202) without the server running it. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}; wait until document.querySelector(".messages-container")?.textContent includes "Hello! I'm Shelley, your AI assistant." (allow 15s).
2. Fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with "echo: fast reply" and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]).
3. The Stop button (button[aria-label="Stop"]) should become visible: the optimistic Thinking state.
4. Call "release".
5. The Stop button should become hidden.
